name: RapidAPI
description: RapidAPI (per its own documentation) is "the world's largest API hub," used by millions of developers to discover, test, and connect to thousands of third-party APIs using a single API key, while also letting API providers distribute and monetize their APIs.
best_for: RapidAPI's documentation states it serves API consumers integrating existing APIs, API builders/providers wanting to distribute and monetize APIs, and teams/enterprises needing centralized management of internal API ecosystems.
features: Unified API access via a single key/format across thousands of APIs
Usage analytics dashboard (requests, latency, error rates)
API monetization options for providers (public/private, revenue models)
Automated API testing and monitoring tools
Team/organization collaboration and API ownership management
Studio platform for building and publishing APIs (REST, SOAP, GraphQL)

alternatives.name: Kong
alternatives.description: Provides API gateway and management infrastructure for organizations to connect, secure, and govern their own APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Platform/API teams managing internal or partner-facing API infrastructure at scale.

alternatives.name: Apigee
alternatives.description: Google Cloud's enterprise API management platform for designing, securing, publishing, and analyzing APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing to manage and expose many internal/partner APIs with strong governance.
